Nevertheless tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:461 (hro_commitment) unconditionally says "Before mutations, seeded REQ-ENG-2 budget450000.00 and movements-200000.00/-197000.00 yield53000.00 headroom, not its stale60000.00 planning scalar." The actual optional seed contains that requisition at environment/assets/seed_data.json:101-105 and movements at :395-402. This is bounded to one functional item (weight 0.48226950 out of 45, at most 0.00643026 overall above gates/floor); P2 denotes bounded impact, not clearance. A paper adversarial comparison was made: an empty-operational-desk implementation with correct live movement netting has no required reason to supply REQ-ENG-2, while an importer hardcoding the advertised seeded 53000 figure could satisfy that seeded sub-observation without establishing generalized netting. The fresh P4 witness is useful but does not make the optional roster mandatory. Evidence limit: source conflict verified from current frozen bytes; no configured judge was run against the conforming empty-desk alternative. The current raw index hashes all matched (50/50) and verification-local source hashes matched. Its own classification explicitly excludes full configured grading/timing, Oracle/target-model scores and empirical reward ordering; these missing measurements are not waived or inferred from scripted golden evidence.
